note: The thirteen node types and how the directory groups each one. Order here is the order on the front page.

entries.name: Countries
entries.blurb: Where people fly for treatment, what each country sells, and who counts the arrivals.

entries.name: Cities
entries.blurb: The clusters: a street of dental surgeries, a hospital district, a corridor of hair clinics.

entries.name: Procedures
entries.blurb: The operations people cross borders for, what each one involves, and what it costs where.

entries.name: Hospitals and clinics
entries.blurb: Named institutions with an international patient department, their beds, their accreditations, their published prices.

entries.name: The journey
entries.blurb: Records, quotes, deposits, visas, interpreters, the flight home, the follow-up nobody booked.

entries.name: Risks
entries.blurb: What goes wrong, how often anybody measures it, and who carries the cost when it does.

entries.name: Rules
entries.blurb: Visas, licensing regimes, entitlements, reimbursement, and the things a country will not do for a visitor.

entries.name: Organizations
entries.blurb: Accreditors, ministries, trade bodies, registries, the societies that write the standards.

entries.name: People
entries.blurb: Surgeons, founders, regulators, researchers, patients who wrote it down.

entries.name: Events
entries.blurb: The conferences, the rulings, the outbreaks, the years the field turned.

entries.name: Words
entries.blurb: Package price, facilitator, day case, DRG, graft, cycle, tariff — with roots.

entries.name: The data
entries.blurb: Every series this site draws a chart from, what it counts, and the sentence about what it does not count.

entries.name: Stories
entries.blurb: Longer pieces: whether it is cheaper, who really travels, what the numbers cannot see.
